ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment centrally located at the peduncle and extending to the notch. Large, high-contrast white contiguous regions occupy the outer two-thirds of both lobes. A thick, irregular black border defines the trailing edge and tips, with fine-grained black mottling transitioning into the white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 52 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations. Distinctive deep V-shaped nicks are present on the upper-inner portion of the left lobe and the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit a strong upward sweep with a concave trailing edge profile and a convex leading edge profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct light-grey irregular clusters located within the black pigment on either side of the central notch. Scattered small, dark circular spots are present across the white surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark, unaligned linear marks (rake-like patterns) visible on the white region of the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notches and tissue missing along the trailing edge, including a prominent jagged indentation on the right lobe tip and a deep nick on the left lobe inner trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized clusters of orange-brown pixels, likely biological epibionts, visible on the white surface of the left lobe.
